_comment: Regions in expectOk are verified-working camera APIs (probe run 2026-07-10) — the scheduled endpoint-health workflow fails (and opens an issue) if any of them stop serving cameras. Regions NOT listed are broken registry entries probed report-only; promote them here once scripts/probe-endpoints.mjs shows them working.

notes.SK,MB,NB,NS,PE,NL,YT,NY,PA,CT,GA,FL,WI,L: IBI 511 API returns HTTP 400 even with format=json — these deployments almost certainly require a registered API key (AB and ON don't enforce one). Fix: register for per-state 511 developer keys, or have the cors-proxy Worker inject keys server-side.
notes.OH: publicapi.ohgo.com returns 401 — requires an API key
notes.MN,IA,NE,CO,MA,IN,KS: endpoints serve an SPA index page — these states migrated off the IBI api/v2 platform
notes.WY,MT,MO,MS,SD,OK,IL,NM: 404 — endpoint URLs are dead and need rediscovery
notes.QC: Quebec WFS returns HTTP 400 — query parameters need rechecking
notes.SC,VA,TN,AL,AR: serve HTML pages, not the IBI JSON API
notes.OR,MD,ND,KY,DE: working but normalizers map no image URLs — check the probe's 'raw fields' note to fix the field mapping
